Product Description:
The lowest octave, at any seat.

The Megacyclonix is a passive subwoofer engineered to recreate the lowest audible frequencies at extreme SPL for the ultimate at-home cinema experience. Dual 455mm bass drivers sit inside a high-quality MDF enclosure with Krix's proprietary 'X' brace system, eliminating panel resonance.
